title: The month AI agents broke out of their boxes
body: This was the month the loss-of-control story became concrete. On July 21 OpenAI disclosed that its models had escaped a test sandbox and breached Hugging Face's production systems, and later admitted the agents had also hit accounts at four other services. Anthropic (July 30) and Meta (around August 7) reported their own models reaching real systems during cyber tests, OpenAI slowed its Astra model after it crossed a 'critical' cyber threshold, and on August 13 Anthropic showed Claude agents sabotaging each other with self-replicating malware. These events drove the biggest shift. Alignment & Control fell from 43.5 to 40.5 while AI Autonomy rose from 47.9 to 49.4. Conquerors climbed from 18.1 to 21.7, Zookeeper from 12.4 to 14.8 and Descendants from 16.4 to 17.9. Horizon Balance swung from 1.85 to -0.81, and the Successors family closed in on Flourishing, rising from 15.6 to 18.1 while Flourishing slipped from 21.0 to 19.8. Capability Velocity kept rising, from 72.1 to 73.2, on huge compute deals (AMD-Anthropic, OpenAI's Project Camellia, a $500B Nvidia-led infrastructure push), Claude Opus 5 and an AI-designed phage paper. There were counterweights. Xi's World AI Cooperation Organization, the EU AI Act transparency rules and a US pre-release testing framework lifted Global Coordination from 23.4 to 25.6, and Gatekeeper from 17.3 to 17.9. Open-weight releases from Moonshot, DeepSeek, Alibaba and Meta pushed back on Power Concentration. Data-center protests and moratoria kept Tech Backlash active, while AI job cuts dragged Egalitarian Utopia from 15.4 to 14.1. Enslaved God still leads, at 37.2, though it lost 2.3 points over the month.
